title: 5.6.4 Debugging: The sound on every frame
description: Two planted bugs. Press Space once and the sound stutters; then it stops working after a reload. Find both.
unit: 5.6 Pinball: a sound on a hit

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Click the canvas and hold Space: the sound repeats as fast as the frames run.

steps.title: Bug 1: the play call is outside the key test
steps.instructions: Move `blip.play()` inside `if (kb.presses('space'))`, and use `presses` rather than `pressing`.

steps.title: Bug 2: the load is inside draw()
steps.instructions: The sound is loaded in `draw()`, once per frame. Move `loadSound(...)` into `setup()` so it loads once.

requirements.title: Played inside the key test
requirements.description: play() is inside a key test, not in draw() on its own. Help: 5.6.1 (Reading: A sound on a hit)

requirements.title: Loaded once
requirements.description: loadSound is called once, in setup(), not inside draw(). Help: 5.6.1 (Reading: A sound on a hit)
